messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

I am trying to put my data together with data2oscr() function, but I keep getting this error here:

"some occassion names in EDF not in TDF"

I don't understand it, because in my TDF I only have the trap names (which is same with trap names in the EDF) and X, Y coordinates. I don't have trap operation info or covariates for occasions. So there shouldn't be any occasion names there.

Also everything was working fine previously  but then I changed the structure of the data (changes what counts as sessions and occasions, but still same data).

Any ideas?

Thanks in advance.
Dilsad
